messages.subject: Project Willow - instruction re Pennine facilities
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Further to our call, the Board would like to formally instruct Whitfield Carter on the Pennine Business Bank position. As you know we tripped the leverage and DSCR covenants for the quarter to 31 December and the Bank has reserved its rights. We need to get on the front foot - ideally a standstill while we work up a consensual deal with a shareholder equity injection.

Can you send an engagement letter and let us know the team? Please keep references to "Project Willow".

Patricia

Patricia Vaughan
General Counsel & Company Secretary
Calverton Industries Limited

messages.subject: RE: Project Willow - instruction re Pennine facilities
messages.plaintextBody:
Patricia,

Thank you - we'd be glad to act. Engagement letter attached. James Osei will run day to day, with Elena Marchetti supporting; I'll stay close given the sensitivity. The Bank is using Pendle Voss.

My strong recommendation is to document a standstill before the 31 March interest date and to commission an IBR from Marlow in parallel. I'll send a short advice note on the Bank's rights this week.

Please countersign and return at your convenience.

Sarah Whitfield
Partner, Restructuring & Finance
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
